description: This file defines an abstract class 'Pdf' for generating PDF files within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including configuration for paper size, orientation, font, and temporary directory management.

classes.name: Pdf
classes.description: Abstract class for PDF writing in PhpSpreadsheet, extending Html writer, managing PDF-specific settings and file handling.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the current font used for PDF generation.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for PDF output, with examples like 'arialunicid0-japanese'.

methods.name: getPaperSize
methods.description: Returns the current paper size setting.

methods.name: setPaperSize
methods.description: Sets the paper size using predefined constants from PageSetup.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the page orientation, e.g., landscape or portrait.

methods.name: getTempDir
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory used for PDF generation.

methods.name: setTempDir
methods.description: Sets the temporary directory for intermediate PDF files, validates directory existence.

methods.name: prepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the file for saving, opens file handle.

methods.name: restoreStateAfterSave
methods.description: Restores state after saving by closing file handle.
